package com.collectionlogroulette.model; /** * Lifecycle of the single assignment slot the player occupies. * *
    *
  • {@link #NONE} — nothing assigned, rolling is allowed.
    • *
  • {@link #ACTIVE} — an assignment is in progress; it must be completed, * skipped or explicitly reset before another roll.
    • *
  • {@link #COMPLETED} — the result is being shown; rolling is allowed * again and does not destroy anything (the result is already in history).
    • *
*/ public enum AssignmentState { NONE, ACTIVE, COMPLETED }

package com.collectionlogroulette.service; import com.collectionlogroulette.model.ActivityType; import com.collectionlogroulette.model.CollectionLogTab; import com.collectionlogroulette.model.DifficultyTier; import com.collectionlogroulette.model.RouletteActivity; import com.google.common.collect.ImmutableList; import com.google.common.collect.ImmutableMap; import java.util.Collection; import java.util.List; import java.util.Map; import javax.annotation.Nullable; import javax.inject.Inject; import javax.inject.Singleton; import net.runelite.api.gameval.ItemID; import net.runelite.api.gameval.NpcID; import net.runelite.api.gameval.VarbitID; /** * The static catalog of rollable activities. * *

Every item and NPC id below is a {@code net.runelite.api.gameval} constant, * so the compiler is what guarantees the names exist — there are no bare magic * numbers to drift out of date. Completion varbits come from * {@link VarbitID}'s {@code COLLECTION_*_COMPLETED} family, which the game sets * to 1 once every slot on the matching Collection Log page has been obtained. * *

Item set coverage

* The item sets are curated, not generated, and are deliberately conservative: * a wrong id would cause a false automatic completion, which is worse than no * mapping at all. Where coverage is partial (notably the harder clue tiers) an * unlock that is not in the set does not complete the assignment; it * surfaces in the panel as a confirmation prompt instead. See CONTRIBUTING.md * for how to extend a set. */ @Singleton public class ActivityCatalog { private final List activities; private final Map byId; @Inject public ActivityCatalog() { this(buildActivities()); } /** * Builds a catalog over an explicit activity list. * *

Exists so tests can exercise selection and assignment logic against a * small fixed set instead of the real catalog, whose contents change every * time an activity is added. */ public ActivityCatalog(List activities) { this.activities = ImmutableList.copyOf(activities); final ImmutableMap.Builder index = ImmutableMap.builder(); for (RouletteActivity activity : this.activities) { index.put(activity.getId(), activity); } this.byId = index.build(); } public List getActivities() { return activities; } @Nullable public RouletteActivity getById(@Nullable String id) { return id == null ? null : byId.get(id); } public int size() { return activities.size(); } /** * Finds every catalog activity that claims the given collection log item. * An item can legitimately belong to more than one activity (the godsword * shards drop from all four God Wars bosses, for instance). */ public Collection findByItemId(int itemId) { final ImmutableList.Builder matches = ImmutableList.builder(); for (RouletteActivity activity : activities) { if (activity.containsItem(itemId)) { matches.add(activity); } } return matches.build(); } private static List buildActivities() { final ImmutableList.Builder b = ImmutableList.builder(); // ------------------------------------------------------------------ // Bosses // ------------------------------------------------------------------ b.add(RouletteActivity.builder() .id("barrows") .displayName("Barrows") .type(ActivityType.BOSS) .difficulty(DifficultyTier.ENTRY) .tab(CollectionLogTab.BOSSES) .iconItemId(ItemID.BARROWS_DHAROK_WEAPON) .completionVarbitId(VarbitID.COLLECTION_BOSSES_BARROWS_COMPLETED) .enabledByDefault(true) .items( ItemID.BARROWS_AHRIM_HEAD, ItemID.BARROWS_AHRIM_WEAPON, ItemID.BARROWS_AHRIM_BODY, ItemID.BARROWS_AHRIM_LEGS, ItemID.BARROWS_DHAROK_HEAD, ItemID.BARROWS_DHAROK_WEAPON, ItemID.BARROWS_DHAROK_BODY, ItemID.BARROWS_DHAROK_LEGS, ItemID.BARROWS_GUTHAN_HEAD, ItemID.BARROWS_GUTHAN_WEAPON, ItemID.BARROWS_GUTHAN_BODY, ItemID.BARROWS_GUTHAN_LEGS, ItemID.BARROWS_KARIL_HEAD, ItemID.BARROWS_KARIL_WEAPON, ItemID.BARROWS_KARIL_BODY, ItemID.BARROWS_KARIL_LEGS, ItemID.BARROWS_KARIL_AMMO, ItemID.BARROWS_TORAG_HEAD, ItemID.BARROWS_TORAG_WEAPON, ItemID.BARROWS_TORAG_BODY, ItemID.BARROWS_TORAG_LEGS, ItemID.BARROWS_VERAC_HEAD, ItemID.BARROWS_VERAC_WEAPON, ItemID.BARROWS_VERAC_BODY, ItemID.BARROWS_VERAC_LEGS) // The six brothers. Note the chest reward is what actually grants the // log slot, so this counter reads as "brothers slain", not "chests". .npcs( NpcID.BARROWS_AHRIM, NpcID.BARROWS_DHAROK, NpcID.BARROWS_GUTHAN, NpcID.BARROWS_KARIL, NpcID.BARROWS_TORAG, NpcID.BARROWS_VERAC) .build()); b.add(RouletteActivity.builder() .id("giant_mole") .displayName("Giant Mole") .type(ActivityType.BOSS) .difficulty(DifficultyTier.ENTRY) .tab(CollectionLogTab.BOSSES) .iconItemId(ItemID.MOLE_CLAW) .completionVarbitId(VarbitID.COLLECTION_BOSSES_MOLE_COMPLETED) .enabledByDefault(true) .items(ItemID.MOLE_CLAW, ItemID.MOLE_SKIN, ItemID.MOLEPET) .npcs(NpcID.MOLE_GIANT) .build()); b.add(RouletteActivity.builder() .id("dagannoth_kings") .displayName("Dagannoth Kings") .type(ActivityType.BOSS) .difficulty(DifficultyTier.MID) .tab(CollectionLogTab.BOSSES) .iconItemId(ItemID.BERZERKER_RING) .completionVarbitId(VarbitID.COLLECTION_BOSSES_DAGANNOTH_COMPLETED) .enabledByDefault(true) .items( ItemID.SEER_RING, ItemID.RANGER_RING, ItemID.WARRIOR_RING, ItemID.BERZERKER_RING, ItemID.DAGANOTH_CAVE_MAGIC_SHORTBOW, ItemID.MUD_BATTLESTAFF, ItemID.DRAGON_AXE, ItemID.SUPREMEPET, ItemID.PRIMEPET, ItemID.REXPET) // All three kings count towards the same assignment. .npcs(NpcID.DAGCAVE_RANGED_BOSS, NpcID.DAGCAVE_MAGIC_BOSS, NpcID.DAGCAVE_MELEE_BOSS) .build()); // God Wars Dungeon.
